summary: Executed Dynamic Prices and Automated Ingestion architecture: built api/ingestion.py with Bengali numeral normalizer, range parser, and CSV ingestion engine; updated api/prices.py with /upload-csv, /sync-scraper, /history, and /summary endpoints; migrated PostgreSQL schema with price_history table and seeded 7-day trend snapshots; and added an interactive Dynamic Prices & CSV Seeding console with SVG trend charts and normalizer playground to the frontend portal.
